title.rendered: Container Offices for Sale in Kengeri

content.rendered:
Looking for a container office in Kengeri that is ready for real work on day one? SAMAN Portable manufactures container offices for sale in Kengeri and delivers them across Bengaluru direct from our own factory at Gopasandra, Bengaluru 560099. Because we build the units ourselves on an MS steel frame, you deal with the maker, not a reseller, and you get a finished, lockable workspace placed on your Kengeri site instead of a bare shipping box.

Container Offices for Sale in Kengeri

A container office is a factory-built steel cabin fitted out as a working office — flooring, wall lining, wiring points, lights, a door and windows. SAMAN Portable supplies 10ft, 20ft and 40ft container offices for sale in Kengeri, built at our Bengaluru factory and delivered ready to use. You buy the unit outright, place it on a level surface, and start work the same day it lands.

Container office sizes we supply

We build three standard container office sizes. Each one is made to order, so the internal layout, window count and electrical points are set to how you plan to use the cabin.

SizeTypical useGood for
10ftSingle-desk site office, security or supervisor cabin1–2 people
20ftStandard office room with desks, storage and AC point3–5 people
40ftLarger office, partitioned cabin or office-plus-pantry layout6–10 people

Need a different internal split, extra windows, a toilet partition or a stacked two-level setup? Tell us the use and we quote the right configuration. For the full range and current pricing, see our container office range.

Why buy your container office direct from SAMAN

SAMAN Portable is the manufacturer, so the container office you place in Kengeri is built and quality-checked in our own Bengaluru factory before it leaves. The build and the support that come with it:

  • MS steel frame to IS 2062 — the structural frame and base use mild-steel sections built to the IS 2062 standard for strength and a straight, square cabin.
  • ISO 9001:2015 quality system — units are produced under a documented quality-managed process.
  • Factory-built near Kengeri — manufactured at Gopasandra, Bengaluru 560099, so delivery into Kengeri is a short, controlled run.
  • Warranty: 5 years structural frame and base + 1–2 years finishing + 20–25 years engineered service life. (The 20–25 years is the engineered service life of the structure, not a warranty period.)
  • Delivery and returns: standard delivery from ₹3,000 with transit of 3–5 days, and returns accepted within 7 days of delivery or installation.

Buying direct means no marketplace mark-up and one point of contact from quote to placement.

Delivery and installation in Kengeri

We deliver finished container offices across Bengaluru, including Kengeri and the surrounding areas. The cabin travels fully built on a truck, so site work on your end is simple: a firm, level patch with clear access for the delivery vehicle. On arrival the unit is offloaded and set in position, and standard models are usable straight away once placed. For sites that need power or water, those connections are made by your electrician or plumber to the points we provide. If access at your Kengeri location is tight, let us know the road width and gate size when you enquire so we plan the right vehicle.

Get a container office quote in Kengeri

Tell us the size you need, how many people will use it, and where in Kengeri it is going, and we will send a current quote with the right specification. Pricing depends on size, internal layout and finishing, so we quote per requirement rather than a fixed list. Call +91 88616 22859 or use Send Enquiry to start, or browse the full range on our container offices page.

FAQs


What sizes of container office can I buy in Kengeri?

We supply 10ft, 20ft and 40ft container offices in Kengeri. The 10ft suits one or two people, the 20ft is a standard office room, and the 40ft works for larger teams or a partitioned layout. Each is built to order.


How long does delivery to Kengeri take?

Standard transit is 3–5 days once your order and specification are confirmed, with delivery from ₹3,000. The cabin arrives fully built from our Bengaluru factory and is set in position on your level, accessible site.


Can I customise the container office layout?

Yes. Because every unit is made to order, you can set the internal partitions, number of windows, electrical points, AC provision and door position. Tell us how you will use the cabin and we build it to suit.


What warranty comes with a SAMAN container office?

Each unit carries 5 years structural frame and base + 1–2 years finishing + 20–25 years engineered service life. The 20–25 years describes the engineered service life of the steel structure, not a warranty term.


How do I get a price for my Kengeri site?

Pricing depends on size, layout and finishing, so we quote per requirement. Call +91 88616 22859 or use Send Enquiry with your size and location, and we will send a current quote.


Do you sell the units or only rent them?

This page is for container offices for sale — you buy the unit outright and own it. For the full range and to confirm current pricing, see our container offices product page or send an enquiry.

author.description: Aman Dubey is the lead marketing and copywriting expert at Saman Portable, specializing in prefabricated, shipping-container, and modular structures. With over 15 years of industry experience, Aman has helped global clients optimize design, streamline production, and amplify brand visibility through data-driven content and strategic SEO. Under his guidance, Saman Portable has become a trusted name in container office solutions and turnkey prefabricated buildings across India and beyond.
